title: buildOrgScope() returns req.orgId for a non-super-admin regardless of a supplied orgId query param
description: client-frameworks.controller.js buildOrgScope() only honours req.query.orgId when the caller has the organization.admin permission. Guards against a regular org user widening their own scope by appending ?orgId=<other-org> to a request.
steps: Call buildOrgScope(req) with req.orgId = 'orgA' and req.query.orgId = 'orgB'
expectedResult: Returns 'orgA' (req.orgId) — the orgB query param is ignored entirely for non-super-admins.

title: buildOrgScope() returns null (unrestricted) for a super-admin who omits orgId
steps: Call buildOrgScope(req) with organization.admin permission and no orgId query param
expectedResult: Returns null, meaning listByProject/availableFrameworks apply no organizationId filter and return data across all orgs for that project.

title: assertOrgAccess() throws 403 when entity.organizationId does not match req.orgId for a non-super-admin
steps: Call assertOrgAccess({ organizationId: 'orgB' }, req) where req.orgId = 'orgA' and req.permissions lacks organization.admin
expectedResult: Throws AppError.forbidden('Access denied'). Used by archiveFromProject/archiveByFrameworkId/updateExcludedControls to stop an org A user from mutating an org B ClientFramework record even if they guess a valid _id.

title: getLicensedFrameworkIds() honours only active/cancel_at_period_end/grace statuses in project billing mode
description: frameworkLicensing.js: when org.billingMode === 'project', licensing is resolved from SubscriptionProject.frameworkSubscriptions filtered to status in ['active','cancel_at_period_end','grace']. Any other status (e.g. 'canceled', 'past_due') must not count as licensed.
preconditions: SubscriptionProject has one entry each with status 'active', 'grace', and 'canceled'
expectedResult: Returned Set contains the frameworkIds for the 'active' and 'grace' entries only — the 'canceled' entry's frameworkId is excluded.

title: getLicensedFrameworkIds() falls back to legacy org.licensedFrameworks only when no embedded frameworkSubscriptions with frameworkId exist
description: New billing flows always persist frameworkId + commercialStatus on org.subscription.frameworkSubscriptions, making that array authoritative (including a legitimate all-cancelled empty Set). The legacy org.licensedFrameworks whitelist is consulted only when embeddedWithIds.length === 0, for orgs that predate the migration.
steps: Case A: org has embedded frameworkSubscriptions with frameworkId but all detached/cancelled, plus a populated legacy licensedFrameworks array
Case B: org has no embedded frameworkSubscriptions at all, only a legacy licensedFrameworks array
expectedResult: Case A returns an empty Set (legacy array is NOT consulted, since embeddedWithIds.length > 0). Case B returns the legacy licensedFrameworks IDs as a Set.

title: updateExcludedControls filters out requirement IDs that don't belong to the target framework
description: client-frameworks.controller.js updateExcludedControls only accepts candidate IDs that resolve to a FrameworkRequirement with matching frameworkId, status:'active' and isLeaf:true. IDs from another framework, non-leaf clause IDs, or malformed ObjectId strings are all silently dropped rather than erroring.
preconditions: Framework F1 has active leaf requirement R1
Framework F2 (different framework) has active leaf requirement R2
F1 also has a non-leaf clause requirement R3
expectedResult: Only R1 is persisted. R2 (wrong framework), R3 (non-leaf) and the malformed string are all filtered out of the saved array.

title: availableFrameworks sorts added-first, then licensed-first, then alphabetically by title
description: The comparator in availableFrameworks() applies three tiers in order: isAdded desc, isLicensed desc, then title/name localeCompare. Verifies all three tiers, not just the first.
preconditions: Catalog contains: Framework Z (added), Framework A (not added, licensed), Framework M (not added, unlicensed)
steps: Inspect the order of the returned frameworks array
expectedResult: Order is [Z, A, M] — added frameworks first regardless of alphabet, then unadded-but-licensed, then unlicensed, each tier alphabetical within itself.

title: coverageStatus() maps a coverage percentage to the correct status bucket at each threshold boundary
description: grc-framework/page.jsx coverageStatus(pct): >=80 compliant, >=50 in-progress, >0 at-risk, else not-started. Boundary values (exactly 80, exactly 50, exactly 0) are the most likely off-by-one spot.
steps: Call coverageStatus(80), coverageStatus(79.9), coverageStatus(50), coverageStatus(49.9), coverageStatus(0.1), coverageStatus(0)
expectedResult: Returns 'compliant', 'in-progress', 'in-progress', 'at-risk', 'at-risk', 'not-started' respectively — the boundaries are inclusive on the lower end (>=80, >=50) and exclusive at 0.

title: getFrameworkCoverage() averageScore rounds the mean of active requirements' coverageScore
description: client-compliance-aggregation.service.js getFrameworkCoverage sums coverageScore across all status:'active' ClientRequirement docs for the framework and divides by count, then Math.round()s. Only active requirements are included — archived/excluded ones must not dilute or inflate the average.
expectedResult: totalRequirements = 3, averageScore = Math.round((100+100+51)/3) = 84. The archived requirement's 0 is excluded from both the count and the sum.
